summary: ACC decision authority, step 2 of 2 (Ed 2026-10-20). Apply ONLY after the decision-authority code (PR #239) is deployed and verified. Changes acc_decisions.status default to pending_review and adds trigger trg_acc_decisions_decision_authority: a row created as or moving into finalizing/decided with an approval or denial needs an authorized decision record (ed/annie/amanda, matching outcome, governing provision or written delegation instrument; committee/Board approval for a paving expansion or deviation; a delegated approval must be a routine clearly compliant one; agents need a compliance evaluation and, when escalated, Ed's prior review). Rows already decided are untouched; no row changes.

preflight.name: 540 columns are present
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'acc_decisions' AND column_name IN ('approval_gate','owner_review','decision_record','compliance_evaluation')

preflight.name: the guard trigger does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_acc_decisions_decision_authority'

preflight.name: no case is mid-finalization
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM acc_decisions WHERE status = 'finalizing'

expected_changes: Creates function acc_decisions_decision_authority_guard() + trigger trg_acc_decisions_decision_authority (BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE).
No row changes; existing decided rows keep their status and data.

verify.name: trigger present
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_acc_decisions_decision_authority'
